      { "name": "get_prometheus_config", "description": "The RUNNING Prometheus configuration as the server reports it (/api/v1/status/config) plus its witnessed config-file path (/api/v1/status/flags --config.file).",
        "inputSchema": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {} } },
      { "name": "get_scrape_targets", "description": "Active scrape targets: job, instance, health, lastError (lean fields).",
        "inputSchema": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {} } },
      { "name": "get_rules", "description": "Loaded recording/alerting rule groups.",
        "inputSchema": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {} } },
      { "name": "query_metric", "description": "Instant PromQL query (read-only, <=512 chars, result capped at 50 series).",
        "inputSchema": { "type": "object", "required": ["query"], "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": { "query": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 512 } } } },
      { "name": "get_grafana_datasources", "description": "Provisioned Grafana datasources, credentials deep-redacted by key.",
        "inputSchema": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {} } },
      { "name": "list_grafana_dashboards", "description": "Dashboard inventory (uid, title, folder).",
        "inputSchema": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {} } },
      { "name": "get_grafana_dashboard", "description": "One dashboard's full JSON model by uid (as-provisioned artifact).",
        "inputSchema": { "type": "object", "required": ["uid"], "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": { "uid": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$" } } } },
      { "name": "get_otel_config", "description": "The otel-collector config AS DEPLOYED (read-only file mount; the collector has no config API).",
        "inputSchema": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {} } },
      { "name": "get_ingress_config", "description": "The OTLP ingress configuration AS DEPLOYED: every nginx config file in front of the collector's OTLP gRPC and HTTP receivers (read-only file mount).     ]
  }
}
